name: image-puma
description: Plan and run local batch image preparation from Claude Desktop.
long_description: Image Puma runs locally over stdio. It plans batch compression, resize, crop, naming, and metadata-cleaning work before writing files, and requires explicit confirmation before running a stored plan.

allowed_directories.title: Allowed Image Folders
allowed_directories.description: Folders Image Puma may read images from and write planned outputs into.

tools.name: image_puma_plan
tools.description: Create a read-only Image Puma batch plan for allowed local image paths.

tools.name: image_puma_run
tools.description: Run a previously created Image Puma plan after explicit confirmation.

tools.name: image_puma_list_presets
tools.description: List MCP-available built-in and user presets.

tools.name: image_puma_describe_preset
tools.description: Return exact settings for one MCP-available preset.

tools.name: image_puma_settings_schema
tools.description: Return the JSON Schema for custom Image Puma settings accepted by image_puma_plan.

tools.name: image_puma_generate_favicon
tools.description: Generate browser favicon assets plus ICO, ICNS, and PNG app icons from one local image.

prompts.name: image-puma
prompts.description: Plan and run a local batch image job: compress, resize, convert, strip metadata, thumbnails, favicons.
prompts.text: Use the Image Puma MCP tools for this local image task: ${arguments.task}. Create an Image Puma plan only first — call image_puma_plan. Do not run it yet. Pick a preset with image_puma_list_presets, or use custom settings. Show the returned plan, warnings, and planned output paths. Call image_puma_run only after my explicit confirmation.
